messages:
James: PR ready — https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/52901 needs runtime + infra + security quick checks. Small change: prefer_local_kv flag, default false. Target merge Thu 10:00 PT. TL;DR: check ordering and perf under batching.

Carmen: @James I can take runtime tomorrow 08:30 PT. Any perf numbers yet? :eyes:

James: ran staging perf/canary: p99 tokens +1-2% under 1000 concurrent reqs. No CPU spikes. Short log: `p99: 132ms -> 135ms`.

Sophie: Platform note — API unchanged. Concern is rollouts: can we gate via feature flag? If so, I'm comfortable approving once sec + runtime OK.

Ira: Security quick scan — authz header reorder might affect audit extraction. Please add a unit test that asserts header presence/order for our log parser.

James: added test and pushed (commit 3f2d9b). Snippet:
```yaml
- name: ensure-authz-logged
  run: pytest tests/test_auth_logging.py::test_authz_header_order
```

Alex: infra check — looks fine from our side. Confirming there are no TTL/eviction default changes? Will watch memory during canary.

James: no TTL changes. It's purely routing preference. Will run 2-hour staging canary after merge.

merge-bot: PR 52901 queued for merge window at 2025-02-20T18:00:00Z (Thu 10:00 PT). Hold until approvals.

Sophie: I'll approve once runtime + security approve. Can also stage as 10% rollout flag.

Carmen: Runtime LGTM. One note: monitor `kv_cache.miss_rate` in the first hour; it spiked for a different change last month.

Ira: Security LGTM after the test is in. Thanks for the quick patch.

Alex: Infra LGTM. Removing my hold.

James: Thanks everyone — prepping the canary. @merge-bot please proceed at window. :tada:

merge-bot: Acknowledged. Will merge when the window opens and signal back in this thread.
